scripts.build:admin: vite build --config vite.config.admin.js && node tools/check-bundle-secrets.mjs dist-admin
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && npx wrangler deploy --assets=./dist-admin --name=gem-guardians-admin --compatibility-date=2026-11-01
scripts.build:android: vite build --mode android && cap sync android && node tools/gradlew.mjs assemblePlayRelease bundlePlayRelease
scripts.build:onestore: vite build --mode onestore && cap sync android && node tools/gradlew.mjs assembleOnestoreRelease
scripts.cap:android: vite build --mode android && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build:ios && cap sync ios && cap open ios
